G7.rule: Both fastfft rows, all raw trials: DD <= actual engine bound and <= 1.5 * same-trial RustFFT DD error + 1 epsilon. Merged relative errors are diagnostics. Above-DD, scenario-reference and sampled batch gaps prevent complete universal coverage.

G8.reason: Ticket 39 must establish every-length fresh planning; arena warmed minimum-of-five plan_ns cannot establish G8.

G9.limitation: Durations are rounded to 0.1s and ratio to 0.01; a boundary interval is incomplete. The launch manifest must attest empty RUSTFLAGS, normal release, clean targets, equal jobs and CPU 2; stdout cannot attest them.

datacheck.effect_on_performance_verdicts: G1–G6 remain suite-specific; no all-campaign datacheck validation pass.

accuracy.g7_gap_count_units: Audit gap counters include raw plus merged row observations, not independent/unique cases.

limitations: Clock probe is an uncalibrated throughput proxy (ticket 32).
Three processes rotate construction order across only three of eight positions; this does not balance all row positions.
Arena metadata cannot attest all launch variables, idle history, executable hash or source identity; retain the frozen-run manifest.
Only explicitly supplied attempts are audited; rejected earlier attempts must also be retained in the evidence manifest.
